items.title: Germany reports a record 952 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 23,427, according to data from the Robert Koch Institute.
Turkey reports a record 240 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 17,121.
California reports a record 53,711 new cases and 293 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the total of confirmed cases to 1,671,081 cases and death toll to 21,481.
Federal Reserve rate decision: raised by 0.25 point, to a 0.25-0.50% target range (effective 2015-12-16)

Taliban gunmen storm one of the military-run Army Public Schools in the Pakistani city of Peshawar, killing at least 141, including 132 children and nine employees, with most of five hundred students evacuated.
Philippines: 18 – Typhoon Sendong (international name Washi) crossed the Visayas and Mindanao region, leaving almost 1,500 people dead and more than thousands missing.
Federal Reserve rate decision: cut by 0.75 point, to a 0.00-0.25% target range (effective 2008-12-16)
